items.docs: The WordPress REST API discovery document - site name, description, URL, the registered namespaces and every registered route with its methods, arguments and argument schemas. This is the self-describing root this OpenAPI was derived from.
The route index scoped to the wp/v2 namespace.
The registered taxonomies and the content types each applies to.
The registered content types and their REST base paths. MindMaze registers no custom public post type - the corpus is core posts, pages and media.
